question:
**Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word.**

Abolish
solution: The correct answer is '**Construct**'. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • The most appropriate antonym of the word **'Abolish**' is** 'Construst'.** • **Abolish**: The word "**abolish**" in English means to formally end something, such as a law, a system, an institution, or a practice, typically through a legal or official process. [In Hindi, the word for "**abolish**" is "समाप्त करना" (samapt karna) or "निरस्त करना" (nirast karna)] • **Construct**: The word "**construct**" is a verb that means to build, create, or assemble something, usually something physical or conceptual. It involves putting together different elements or parts to form a whole. [In Hindi, the word "construct" can be translated as "निर्माण करना" (nirmaan karna) or "बनाना" (banana).] **Correct Answer:__** *Construct.* [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__** • Let's look at the meaning of other words: • **Reverberate**: (used about a sound) to be repeated several times as it comes off different surfaces. [(ध्वनि का) गूँजना, प्रतिध्वनित होना] • **Eradicate**: to destroy or get rid of something completely. [(रोग आदि) को जड़ से उखाड़ देना, पूर्णतया उन्‍मूलित कर देना] • **Pontificate**: express one's opinions in a pompous and dogmatic way. (अपनी राय को आडंबरपूर्ण और हठधर्मी तरीके से व्यक्त करना) 30:T8c9, The correct answer is **'part of your life'.**
